document.abstract: This report contains the reports of four of the Sub-Committees of the Projection Practice Committee, viz., on the Motion Picture Theater Survey, on Screen Illumination, on Projection Room Plans. and on the Proposed Revision of the NFPA Regulations for Nitrocellulose Motion Picture Film. A preliminary report is rendered by the Sub-Committees on Theater Survey and Screen Brightness. The Projection Room Plans and Revision of the Fire Regulations are presented in full.
